decisions.reason: As a core floor-level shower drainage line aligned with the firm's strategic direction, it would usually be retained unless several years of results now show a clear shortfall versus aspirations.
Because this designer shower drainage line is a flagship closely tied to the firm's future positioning, management would still grant it support and prefer refinement over withdrawal.

This backflow-protected basement drain is a credible niche complement to the drainage portfolio, so it stays if it is at least near aspiration levels, though its narrower role makes review stricter by 2022.

As a more peripheral and less prominently differentiated product, an extended period of uncertain or modest results would by now likely lead management to reallocate resources to stronger core lines and new development.
